title: POST /api/profiles, PATCH /api/profiles/{profile_id} (body)
description: Create an empty profile (POST: name required; rules missing = catalog defaults, fixed/user_choice missing = catalog default_fixed/default_user_choice) or change one (PATCH: every field optional; rules is merged per key, fixed and user_choice replace the whole list). Validation 422 per field (rules.<key>, fixed, user_choice.<key> not allowed, name.duplicate, profile.limit, profile.guest_child_protection). Making a rule fixed deletes its device adjustments; a change of control_path or remote_access that takes a device's Home Assistant key away rotates its HA token - see ?dry_run=true (profile-preview.response.json) before saving.

kind.description: Kind of the profile. POST without kind: person. Changing the kind changes no rule; a profile that is no longer of kind person loses setup_devices (resolved not_applicable).

description.description: One sentence for the profile card.

remote_pin.description: Profile remote PIN: exactly 8 digits, stored only as PBKDF2 hash + salt (fixtures/crypto/settings-pin-vectors); null removes it. Never in log, audit, diff or preview (the audit only notes profile_remote_pin_set).
